C1_days_rest.original_defect: days_rest was computed with groupby(team_id) only, so every season opener inherited the gap since the team's LAST GAME OF THE PREVIOUS SEASON
C1_days_rest.consequence: the original -1.435 bias on '7+ days rest' was substantially an OFF-SEASON artifact. The coordinator's schedule-gap hypothesis (A6) is WITHDRAWN.

C2_support_axis.original_defect: support_bucket was built on n_history_games, which means TEAM games at pace levels 1-2 and CUMULATIVE LEAGUE games at level 3. The original '>10' bucket (n=23, MAE 4.538), presented as ABUNDANT support, is entirely level-3 rows with ZERO team support

source_column_semantics.league_prior_all: n_history_games = CUMULATIVE LEAGUE games (4-1300); TEAM support is ZERO

C2_support_axis.consequence: any arm selected against the original support axis would be selected against a variable whose meaning changes mid-range

C3_pace_level_equals_early_season.classification: CORRECTED (new finding, not in the original packet)
C3_pace_level_equals_early_season.measurement: pace_level > 1 is algebraically equivalent to game_no_in_season <= 3: agree 2982/2982, zero off-diagonal
C3_pace_level_equals_early_season.consequence: the packet's by_pace_level and by_game_no_in_season strata are ONE partition under two names. No design may carry both; in threshold form feature_gate's linear rank check may not see it

C4_ot_window_contamination.consequence: a 4.4% event contaminates ~33% of trailing windows; any OT-handling correction has ~7x the leverage the raw OT count suggests

C5_unit_diagnostics.note: reported under BOTH units so the ruling is not made on the basis of which looks better. See PHASE0A_RESOLUTION.md section 2.

C6_head_to_head_coverage.original_discrepancy: pace_coaching reported 70.2%; the coordinator measured 85.1%; the synthesis refused to quote either
C6_head_to_head_coverage.resolution: NOT RECONCILED. I tested four denominators (all team-games, resolved rows only, level-1 rows only, playoffs with >=3 prior meetings) and NONE reproduces 70.2%; they span 85.1-87.4%, and playoffs come out at 100.0% against the source's 99.1%. The discrepancy is therefore NOT a denominator difference, which is what I first assumed and could not substantiate. Either the source used a different meeting definition (e.g. excluding the current game's own prior meetings, or counting within the trailing window rather than the season), or one of the two computations is wrong. UNRESOLVED — no figure may be quoted in a task card until reconciled directly with the source.

C7_venue_travel_elevation_timezone.original_statement: 'travel distance / time-zone change: ABSENT; would need venue geocoding'

actual.verdict: AVAILABLE — travel, elevation and time zone are constructible; moves Category B -> Category A

also.verdict: PARTIAL — 2021 coverage is zero and provenance is odds-derived rather than as-of; stays Category B

C8_injury_transaction_history.verdict: AVAILABILITY established; CUTOFF VALIDITY not established. The file carries NO observation timestamp, so its cutoff status rests on `date` being an event date rather than a compilation date. Remains Category B on cutoff grounds, NOT on availability grounds.

C9_retrospective_bulk_scrape.classification: CORRECTED (a source's count corrected; its conclusion stands)
C9_retrospective_bulk_scrape.source_claim: master_team has two distinct observed_time values
C9_retrospective_bulk_scrape.measured: TEN distinct values, in two bulk windows (2026-07-31 20:42:42-45Z and 2026-08-04 12:30:09-22Z) covering game dates from 2021-05-14
C9_retrospective_bulk_scrape.conclusion: the count was wrong; the conclusion is right. master_team is a RETROSPECTIVE BULK SCRAPE, not per-game pregame capture. Any master_team column is cutoff-valid only under a LAG argument, never under a CAPTURE argument, and carries revision risk. possessions_raw_v2 carries no capture timestamp at all.
